corrections.C1_lambda2: lambda_2 of a graph with k>=2 components is identically 0; the criterion 'k>=2 AND lambda_2>=lambda_min' is unsatisfiable. Implemented lambda_{k+1} (gap above the k-dimensional kernel) instead.
corrections.C2_power_iteration: power iteration converges to lambda_max, not lambda_2. Implemented an exact dense symmetric eigensolver, which also certifies kernel multiplicity.
corrections.C3_lemma_M2: Lemma M2 does not transfer TV-specific certificates. Metric-generic results (Lemmas 2-3, Theorem 1, Corollary 1, routing form) transfer; the trace bound (Lemma 1) and the drift bound (Theorem 3) are TV-specific and re-derived.
corrections.C4_capture_radius: r = sqrt(m)*eps is vacuous when eps approaches 1, since psi lies in [0,1]^m and ||psi_x-psi_y|| <= sqrt(m). The candidate filter then admits all pairs. Measured and reported.
corrections.C5_hoeffding_scope: the correlation-integral CI is conditional on the drawn context sample; it bounds |C_hat - C_N|, not |C_hat - C_population|.
corrections.C6_H1_boundary: k constant on [eps_lo, eps_hi) gives cross distances >= eps_hi, not > eps_hi. Reported with >= and eps_out taken as eps_hi.

rationale: Verdict follows the pre-committed §4 rule applied to every metric in §5 B1. One-step TV, rollout root-JS and continuation MMD were each scanned for a plateau under the corrected spectral criterion (lambda_{k+1}). No threshold was relaxed after seeing results. If no metric yields a plateau, branch B3 (hierarchical soft domains) is the pre-committed architectural response.
